_about: 1991 census collection districts (CD_CODE_1991, ABS asgc1991.gpkg) allocated whole to the divisions in force at the 1993 federal election — the map's own published era set, the Parliamentary Handbook historical polygons (.matilda/handbook-boundaries/n-1993-handbook.geojson via handbook_geo.mjs; wragge/historical-federal-electorate-boundaries rev fb76072cfa5e, research-use inputs) — by majority of a 6x6 grid-sample, the same machinery as derive-cd-2001-ced-alloc.py's 2004 lane (machinery shared with derive-ced-era-alloc.py). The membership the 1993 census-people lane pools this census's counts over (derive-booth-demo-{…}.py). No ABS CD-1991 -> election-era concordance exists for this period; the ABS ASGC 1993-adjacent CED frame itself carries post-redistribution geometry (README-history.md). Units outside every era polygon are legal only as ABS-filed balance classes (offshoreClass) or population-free registry pseudos.
